traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one of Insight, Perception, or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours of light meditation.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: Choose a lineage: Drow (Darkvision 120 ft, Dancing Lights), High Elf (Prestidigitation, swap cantrip on Long Rest), or Wood Elf (+5 ft Speed, Druidcraft).
